SELECT a.id, a.s_mail, a.title, a.email_body, a.link, b.ten_mail as ten_s_mail,
       b.username_smail, c.ten_kh as ten_r_mail, b.mk_mail, b.smtp_server, b.smtp_port, b.type_smail, 
       c.e_mail as r_mail
FROM smaildmkh a
LEFT JOIN dmsmail b ON a.s_mail = b.s_mail
CROSS APPLY ISWIFTFunction$Split(a.ds_kh, ',') s
LEFT JOIN dmkh0 c ON s.data = c.ma_so_thue
WHERE a.id = @id and c.e_mail IS NOT NULL and c.e_mail <> ''
